title: Attention Engine fixtures
description: 12 fixture emails covering important, ordinary, and edge-case messages. Each file is a real RFC822 message, parsed by the production MIME parser.
notes: internalDate values are fixed so deadline tests are deterministic.
Thread fixtures share a threadId and expect thread-level analysis.
The `expected` block is advisory metadata for humans; the authoritative assertions live in server/tests/fixtures.test.ts.
